build_booktest_data: build the BookTest dataset by downloading and extracting booktest.tar.bz2 into the ParlAI datapath
download_booktest_resource: download the BookTest resource file from parl.ai into the specified data directory
check_booktest_built: check if the BookTest dataset has already been built in the ParlAI datapath
remove_outdated_booktest: remove an older version of the BookTest dataset directory before rebuilding
mark_booktest_done: mark the BookTest dataset build as complete in the ParlAI build system
